ModMetaData.name: Antiquities
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
The 17th tree: five stages read out of the world one urn at a time. LANGUAGE, RELIGION, CULTURE, CARTOGRAPHY, VOICE — design/Jawa/ antiquities_design.md, RULED 2026-09-04, owner-unblocked 2026-09-04 (the expansion/review sitting the block cited concluded; tree rebrand names/merges stay open, slices 1-2 do not depend on them — labels stay cheap, defNames never rename).
ANTIQUITIES_TREE_BUILD_1 slice 1: the tree, the item family, and the reading loop. Every RUT_Antiq_* node is gated on artifacts examined at the Reading Station, never on lab-hours alone (requiredResearchBuilding points at a bench that is never buildable, so vanilla's own research-bench work can never touch these projects — the only route in is this mod's own WorkGiver, which calls Find.ResearchManager. AddProgress directly). Narrative generator (slice 2), progress meter + LOST ledger (slice 3) and everything past it are separate follow-on work; this ships with placeholder art and a single flavor description per item family — see the item's own build notes.
